description: This file defines the vCard class, which provides functionality to create, load, import, and export vCard data for contact management within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for setting contact properties, importing vCard files, and generating vCard strings.

classes.name: vCard
classes.description: A class for managing vCard contact information, including properties for contact data, methods to load contact data, set properties, import vCards from files, and export vCard strings.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the contact properties to an empty state.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact details from the database based on contact ID, populating the vCard properties accordingly.

methods.name: setORG
methods.description: Sets the organization and department information.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address information including street, city, state, postal code, country, and type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the contact's name and generates the formatted name.

methods.name: setPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets phone number property for specified type (e.g., HOME, WORK, CELL, FAX).

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a given name and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates the vCard formatted string for export.

methods.name: saveVCard
methods.description: Outputs the vCard as a downloadable file or string with appropriate headers.

methods.name: importVCard
methods.description: Reads a vCard file and populates a contact bean with the extracted contact details.
